spec.name: pipeline-matching-compiler-inventory
spec.script_content:
import os,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(os.environ['ARTIFACT_LOCAL_DIR']);out=Path(os.environ['RESULT_LOCAL_DIR'])
files=[]
for p in root.rglob('*'):
 if p.is_file() and ('llo' in str(p).lower() or 'manifest' in p.name):
  files.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(root)),'bytes':p.stat().st_size})
(out/'files.json').write_text(json.dumps(files))
